City of South Lake Tahoe
                      Parks and Recreation Commission
                               Meeting Agenda
                   Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at 8:00 am
  City Hall - City Council Chamber, 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, South Lake Tahoe

Parks and Recreation Commission
Jerry Bindel, Chair (02/2028)
David Gregorich, Co-Chair (02/2028)
Mark Costigan (02/2028)
Peter Fink (02/2027)
Margie Kovarik-Maxhimer (02/2027)
Trudith Morgan (02/2027)
Nicole Ramirez Thomas (02/2027)



Public Participation
Parks and Recreation Commission meetings are held in person at the time and location listed on this
agenda. Remote public participation is available via ZOOM at this link
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88934963024.


A public agenda packet is available for review at City Hall, 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, the Recreation
Complex, 1100 Rufus Allen Boulevard, on the City’s Website at www.cityofslt.us, or by contacting staff at
(530) 542-6059.

Providing Public Comment:

In Person: Every agenda for regular meetings provides an opportunity for members of the public to
directly address the Commission, on any item of public interest which is within the jurisdiction of the
Commission during Public Communications. For items on the agenda or in connection with any item
which the Commission will consider, the public is given the opportunity to comment before or during
consideration of the item [Government Code Section 54954.3(a)].

ZOOM Platform: If you are joining the meeting via ZOOM and would like to make a comment, press the
``raise a hand`` button at the time indicated by the Chair. Press *9 to indicate a desire to make a
comment. Press *6 to unmute your phone.

In Writing: Written comments received by 3 p.m. the day before the meeting will be distributed to the
Commission prior to the meeting. Written public comment regarding any item on this agenda may be
sent to PublicComment@cityofslt.gov. When emailing comments, identify the name of the Commission
and agenda item number in the subject line to which your comments relate. Any such comment that is a
public record and is emailed to PublicComment@cityofslt.gov or otherwise provided to a majority of the

Commission before the meeting will be made available for public inspection during normal business
hours at the City Clerk's Office located at City Hall, 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, South Lake Tahoe
[Government Code Section 54957.5(b)]. Written comments will not be read out loud during the meeting.

The City Council Chambers meeting facility is accessible to people with disabilities. Every reasonable
effort will be made to accommodate any person needing special assistance to attend this meeting.
Contact staff at (530) 542-6197 at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting for assistance [28 CFR
35.102.35.104 ADA Title II and Brown Act Government Code Sections 54953.2, 54954.1, 54954.2, and
54957.5].

Call to Order/Pledge of Allegiance

Roll Call

Public Communication
This is the public's opportunity to speak on any topic NOT LISTED on this agenda. Comments shall be
limited to three (3) minutes. In accordance with the Brown Act, the Commission cannot deliberate or vote
on any matter raised under public communications, but may briefly respond to statements made or
questions posed. (Government Code Sections 54954.2)

New Business

1.   Parks and Recreation Commission Meeting Minutes.
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Pass a motion to approve the Parks & Recreation
     Commission Meeting Minutes for August 19, 2026.
     Responsible Staff Member(s): Kylee Finnegan, Recreation Supervisor
     08.19.26 Parks and Recreation Commission Minutes.docx

2.   Annual Report
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Receive & File.
     Responsible Staff Member(s): John Stark, Director of Parks & Recreation
     01-Staff Report - P&R Commission Annual Report.docx

Unfinished Business

3.   Parks Foundation Update
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Receive & File.
     Responsible Staff Member(s): John Stark, Director of Parks & Recreation
     01-Staff Report - Parks Foundation Update.docx

4.   Recreation Programs Update
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Receive and File
     Responsible Staff Member(s): Kylee Finnegan, Recreation Supervisor
     01-Staff Report -Recreation Programming.docx

Updates and Announcements - City Staff

Commissioner Reports and Comments - Assignments to Sub-Committees
Commissioner Assignments and Sub-Committees
a. Mid-Town Revitalization (Commissioners Gregorich, Bindel, Kovarik-Maxhimer, ALT Ramirez
Thomas)

b. Bijou Area Plan (Commissioners Kovarik-Maxhimer, Gregorich, Morgan, ALT Fink)

c. Recreation and Equitable Access (Commissioners Ramirez Thomas, Bindel, Fink, ALT Open)

d. Bike Mobility and Connectivity (Commissioners Fink, Ramirez Thomas, Kovarik-Maxhimer, ALT Open)

e. Senior Focus (Commissioners Morgan, Gregorich, Fink, ALT Kovarik-Maxhimer)

f. City Council Updates - All

g. Future Agenda Items - All

Adjournment
I, John Stark, Director of Parks and Recreation, declare that the foregoing agenda for the Wednesday,
September 16, 2026, meeting of the Parks and Recreation Commission was posted and available for
review on Friday, September 11, 2026, at the Recreation Complex - 1100 Rufus Allen Boulevard, South
Lake Tahoe, CA 96150. The agenda was also available on the City website at https://www.cityofslt.us.
John Stark, Director of Parks and Recreation Note: Decisions of the Parks and Recreation Commission
may be appealed to the City Council by anyone adversely affected by such action. This appeal shall be
filed with the City Clerk within fifteen (15) business days from the date of the decision with the applicable
appeal fee.
